primaryText: dǝ-kǝ-dǝ ñan gu kǝ-ku kiya-dǝ-k ata gra:d
translation: After/because his son had died after/because he drowned (lit. consumed water) he (father) cried
comment: Both medial clauses, kǝ-ku with the same-subject completive and kiya-dǝ-k with the different-subject completive, read 'after' or 'because'. The translation's coindexing subscripts (his_i son_j, he_j, he_i) are omitted; the source writes schwa, here U+01DD as in the Fragment.

primaryText: dǝ-kǝ-dǝ ñan kiya-n napa-dǝ-k sǝbǝn-ǝn napa-ku makǝn ata ra:d
translation: After/*because his son had died, after/*because he came back, he (father) sat in mourning
comment: Both medial clauses carry the completive auxiliary napa- after a verb in -n, the first with the different-subject and the second with the same-subject completive, and read 'after' but not 'because'; the source sets off the first complex predicate with slashes. The translation's coindexing subscripts (his_i son_j, he_i) are omitted; the source writes schwa, here U+01DD as in the Fragment.
